text:
The assistant completely failed to address the user's request. Instead of analyzing the stock data to extract the highest and lowest closing prices for each month (January, February, March 2022) and formatting the results as a CSV with one line per month, the assistant merely echoed back the original input data verbatim. No grouping, aggregation, or extraction was performed. The response is unhelpful, irrelevant to the specific task, and lacks any analytical depth.

Rating: [[1]]
